messages.subject: Error in mqmscan(jittered, cofactors = cofactors, verbose = T, plot = T,  :    Singular matrix
parts:
Dear Karl,

I had an error on running mqmscanning such as Error in mqmscan(jittered, cofactors = cofactors, verbose = T, plot = T, : Singular matrix and "Missing genotype information, please estimate unknown data, before running mqmscan.". Is there any solution?

Your help would be much appreciated!

Thanks,

Best,

Zhaslan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error in mqmscan(jittered, cofactors = cofactors, verbose = T, plot = T,  :    Singular matrix
parts:
Hard to tell exactly what’s going on from the information provided. We’d prefer if you provided the exact input and output, by copy-paste from R.

mqmscan requires complete genotype data either with fill.geno or mqmaugment.

singular matrix is maybe from using too many marker cofactors.

karl

Dear Zhaslan,

The code you pasted, and the output from it, is very confusing (since it seems to contain 2 or 3 runs of MQM, in the first mapping
it seems that there is too much missing data 55 individuals are expanded by the augmentation step to 519 individuals, then right
after the algorithm restarts and augments to 600 individuals ?!).

In the second part of the output, it has only 55 individuals (no augmentation?) and crashes after it has fit the cofactor on your data.

Could you please send me the script, and the input data on: Danny....@gmail.com ? All data will be handled confidentially,
but I need to be able to reproduce the crash to take a closer look.

Kind regards,
Danny
